resources.string: Point the other phone at something and watch it here. The remote screen is replaced by its camera, so touch does nothing while a camera is selected — use the torch and zoom controls instead.
Asking the device for its cameras…
The device reported no cameras it can capture from.
The camera applies to this session only. Choosing one reconnects without changing saved settings.
Choosing a camera gives this device settings of its own.
The usual behaviour: see and control what is on the other phone.
The session is using this camera, but the device did not list it. Saving keeps it; choose the screen or a listed camera to change.
The device did not return its cameras.
Could not save the camera choice.
A separate mode for the high frame rates some cameras only offer that way. It has its own list of sizes, and the device refuses a size from the ordinary list while it is on.
The device did not list this camera\'s sizes, so it will choose one itself.
Listed sizes come from the camera\'s own declaration. A listed size can still be refused, and the device will fall back to choosing one.
